AdjudicationRecord.title: AdjudicationRecord

CriterionCell.description:
One criterion's baseline-vs-candidate outcome for a single trace (S-3).

The state, verdict, and rationale are computed here in the domain layer; the
frontend renders them and never re-derives an outcome.
CriterionCell.title: CriterionCell

GuardrailGovernance.description:
Baseline-authoritative provenance for one criterion's min_pass_rate
guardrail (PD-V3-19).

The baseline governs the threshold; the candidate — the artifact under
evaluation — may STRENGTHEN it but may never WEAKEN it. Resolution is by
explicit `is not None`, never truthiness, so an explicit candidate 0.0 is a
real value (which cannot lower the baseline), not a falsy fallback trigger.
GuardrailGovernance.title: GuardrailGovernance

ParseIssue.description: One named problem with an uploaded run file.
ParseIssue.title: ParseIssue

Provenance.description: Tamper-evident identifiers; no raw private case content belongs here.
Provenance.title: Provenance

RunReceipt.description: Lifecycle evidence emitted before and after a scheduled product run.
RunReceipt.title: RunReceipt

SizeLimitResponse.description:
The 413 body — one documented shape for either size boundary: the
whole-request cap (the middleware, before parsing) and the per-file cap
(``_read_capped``, at read-back) both emit ``{"detail": str}``.
SizeLimitResponse.title: SizeLimitResponse

TraceComparison.description: One changed trace's full per-criterion detail and evidence fields (S-3).
TraceComparison.title: TraceComparison

ValidationErrorResponse.description:
The single 422 envelope: every validation failure — malformed upload,
out-of-range config, or a native transport type error — is reported as
``{"detail": [ValidationProblem, ...]}`` so one committed schema matches
the wire for all of them (P-4).
ValidationErrorResponse.title: ValidationErrorResponse
